scores.label: Scoped WSG audit score
scores.formula: 100 * passed / (passed + failed + cantTell), grouped once per guideline

impactWeighted.status: Experimental project convention using WSG impact priority points; not a W3C site score

scores.interpretation: Passes satisfy only the declared scoped expectations; unknowns earn no points but are not defects. Compare only matching rubric, sample, and evidence profiles.

guidelines.title: Identify, assess, disclose, review, and mitigate sustainability impacts
guidelines.expectation: A retrieved public sustainability statement identifies the audited service and describes its impacts and mitigation. Judge disclosure only, not execution; an unresolved relationship is cantTell.

judgments.rationale: Retrieved Sustainability explicitly includes reducing wagtail.org impacts; Digital emissions identifies this site's homepage, April 2026 estimate, SWD v4 inputs and monitoring approach. This satisfies disclosure scope without verifying execution or the reported quantities; the ecosystem arithmetic needs clarification.
judgments.nextEvidence: Obtain the underlying measurement and monitoring records for the published claims.

guidelines.title: Understand user requirements or constraints
Integrate sustainability into every stage of the ideation process
Design efficient and streamlined user journeys
guidelines.expectation: Execute declared task actions and inspect completion evidence; an expected selector is one observable, not proof of user success or optimal journey length.

judgments.rationale: The sustainability-footer journey actually clicked footer a[href="/sustainability/"]. The final URL is /sustainability/, document status is 200, and URL, selector and Sustainability text postconditions all succeeded. This establishes the declared route, not optimal usability.
judgments.nextEvidence: Repeat the same task with keyboard navigation.

guidelines.title: Design to assist and not to distract
guidelines.expectation: Assess visible distractions against the declared visitor task; distinguish useful prompts from interruptions.

judgments.rationale: Desktop text includes an event promotion and cookie prompt alongside the reading tasks; recorded dialogs are hidden and the homepage video is paused without autoplay. Geometry and text do not resolve the prompts' visual disruption.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect initial viewport screenshots and observe dismissal while completing the reading task.

guidelines.title: Avoid being manipulative or deceptive
guidelines.expectation: Inspect choice wording, defaults, prominence and the observed accept/reject paths for undue steering. DOM text alone does not establish visual parity.

judgments.rationale: The cookie prompt explains measurement and exposes 'Opt in' and 'Opt out'; homepage controls have equal 319×57 geometry. All six branch clicks completed, but visual prominence, persisted choice and subsequent tracking behavior are not established.
judgments.nextEvidence: Compare button appearance and verify stored consent and tracking after each choice.

guidelines.title: Make deliverables understandable and reusable
guidelines.expectation: Assess the sampled task's wording, headings and terminology for its stated audience; retain uncertainty about unrepresented users.

judgments.rationale: Sustainability desktop text calls 12 tCO2e/year the average for 6431 sites totaling 5173 tons/year; these figures cannot describe the same population and average. Digital emissions more clearly separates its homepage estimate, April 2026 date and method. The contradictory ecosystem wording impairs the declared claims-reading task.
judgments.nextEvidence: Trace the ecosystem figures to their source and clarify the population, statistic and period.

guidelines.title: Use a design system for interface consistency
guidelines.expectation: Compare repeated navigation and control names across sampled pages; consistent samples do not prove a documented design system.

judgments.rationale: Desktop text and controls repeat Project, Explore, Developers, Community, Support, Get started and Open the search across all three pages. This supports sampled naming consistency, not a complete design system.
judgments.nextEvidence: Compare the opened navigation controls across the three pages.

guidelines.title: Optimize media to reduce resource use
guidelines.expectation: The sampled task images preserve useful content and provide proportionate intrinsic dimensions and delivery choices for their rendered size and pixel density. A large image is an investigation candidate until legibility and task value are checked; absent srcset alone is not a failure.

judgments.rationale: Sustainability includes a 1300-pixel-wide WebP chart rendered 660 pixels wide on desktop, alongside smaller images enlarged to 660 pixels. Several images lack srcset; this alone is not failure. Chart readability, intended pixel densities and candidate rendition quality were not assessed.
judgments.nextEvidence: Compare the chart and enlarged images visually at narrow and desktop sizes at intended pixel densities.

guidelines.title: Ensure animation is proportionate and easy to control
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed animation purpose, playback controls and reduced-motion behavior. A quiet snapshot does not prove no motion occurs elsewhere.

judgments.rationale: Desktop animation snapshots are quiet, but reduced_motion records five running one-iteration animations on the homepage and one on Sustainability. Target tags and current times do not establish motion purpose or visible effect. The homepage video has native controls and no autoplay.
judgments.nextEvidence: Identify the recorded animation properties and observe their purpose and reduced-motion treatment.

guidelines.title: Use optimized web typography
guidelines.expectation: Observed web fonts and variants serve the sampled content, with a declared fallback/loading strategy where needed. Do not fail a site merely for using a web font; recommend removal or subsetting only after language and readability requirements are established.

judgments.rationale: document.fonts records Kumbh Sans 400 and 700 loaded, 600 unloaded, with display block for 400 and auto for the others. Body styling declares a sans-serif fallback; two WOFF2 responses are 19304 and 19640 bytes. Constrained-loading readability and required language coverage remain unknown.
judgments.nextEvidence: Block font responses and verify readable task text during loading and after fallback.

guidelines.title: Avoid unwanted notifications
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed alerts and notification permission requests for user value and choice; absence is limited to observed states.

judgments.rationale: Recorded states show zero notification permission request calls; observed dialogs are hidden. Newsletter signup is explicitly offered rather than automatically enabled. This pass covers these anonymous states only; browser permission was already denied.
judgments.nextEvidence: Repeat the reading journey with notification permission unset.

guidelines.title: Reduce the impact of downloadable and physical documents
guidelines.expectation: Review print layout visibility and download labels for the declared task. Fetch and inspect document content before asserting optimization or equivalence.

judgments.rationale: Print states hide navigation and retain task text; download inventories are empty. DOM visibility does not establish usable pagination, unclipped charts or efficient printed output, and no downloadable document was inspected.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect a print preview of the Sustainability and Digital emissions pages.

guidelines.title: Involve users early in the project
Audit and test for bugs or issues requiring resolution
Validate usability through testing and real-world usage
Provide cross-platform compatibility support
guidelines.expectation: The sampled core reading content and navigation remain available without JavaScript, or an explicit alternative supports the task. This bounded check does not establish no-JavaScript search, every interaction, or all browser compatibility.

judgments.rationale: Fresh no_javascript states retain the homepage introduction, sustainability commitments, emissions method and repeated navigation text. Core reading survives without scripts; this does not establish search or every interactive control.
judgments.nextEvidence: Follow the Sustainability link in the no-JavaScript state.

guidelines.title: Set goals based on performance and energy impact
Minify and remove unused code
guidelines.expectation: Use initial JS/CSS execution observations to nominate investigation targets; require representative journeys or source corroboration before recommending removal.

judgments.rationale: codeCoverage captures initial load plus 500 ms and includes unexecuted ranges, not demonstrated dead code. Candidate webpack.config.js uses production mode, cssnano and compressed Sass, but representative interaction coverage and deployment correspondence are missing.
judgments.nextEvidence: Extend coverage through navigation, search, consent and media activation before considering removal.

guidelines.title: Modularize bandwidth-heavy components
guidelines.expectation: Relate initial script resources to visible components and later task needs; recommend splitting only when a component's deferred use and usable activation are corroborated.

judgments.rationale: Initial resources include main.js; candidate base.html loads it globally, and site-search-desktop.js imports MicroModal for click-triggered search. Neither a deployed module attribution nor usable deferred activation is demonstrated, so splitting is not yet justified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Map the deployed main bundle to components and exercise search before comparing a deferred candidate.

guidelines.title: Avoid redundancy and duplication in code
guidelines.expectation: Selected templates or modules use shared components for the same repeated interface behavior. A demonstrated duplicated maintenance path can fail this narrow check; shared imports alone cannot establish whole-project efficiency. Inspect concrete call sites and tradeoffs before recommending consolidation.

judgments.rationale: Candidate header.html invokes the same main_navigation tag for desktop and mobile, and includes shared skip-link and search components; base.html includes shared SVG sprites. This supports selected interface reuse at clean revision 9fa65385f27c15b83c86a4f6e0e3ac18d4784609, not project-wide efficiency or deployed identity.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect the shared navigation implementation and confirm the deployed revision before proposing changes.

guidelines.title: Treat third parties the same as first parties
Ensure code follows good semantic practices
guidelines.expectation: The sampled document has a meaningful language, primary heading and main region, and task controls have visible labels or an explicit naming relationship. Count/attribute presence alone does not establish semantic correctness or WCAG compliance. The sampled initial keyboard path reaches visible task navigation/controls in a meaningful order with a discernible focus indicator. A bounded Tab trace cannot establish complete keyboard support, reverse navigation, traps or screen-reader accessibility.

judgments.rationale: Each desktop document declares en, one main and one H1, and visible controls have text, labels or aria-labels. However, heading inventories truncate at 100 entries before exposing the primary heading, leaving its semantic correspondence to task content unverified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the actual H1 and main contents, and resolve naming references for activated dialogs.

judgments.rationale: Twelve-step traces reach the promotion, skip link, homepage, navigation, search and task links in a meaningful order. Steps report visible geometry, focusVisible=true and 1px auto outlines, but the rendered indicator's discernibility is not directly demonstrated.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect focused screenshots for the skip link, navigation and search control.

guidelines.title: Defer the loading of non-critical resources
Structure metadata for machine readability
guidelines.expectation: The sampled content has a descriptive title and usable canonical metadata when applicable; declared structured-data blocks parse as JSON. Judge description and other optional metadata according to page purpose, not a mandatory-field checklist.

judgments.rationale: All three pages have descriptive titles and exact-page HTTPS canonicals. The homepage's WebPage and Organization blocks parse as JSON; other pages declare none. Digital emissions lacks a description, which is not mandatory for this scoped expectation.
judgments.nextEvidence: Validate the homepage structured data against its intended vocabulary if reuse requires it.

guidelines.title: Use media queries that support sustainability goals
guidelines.expectation: The sampled page respects applicable dark/reduced-motion preferences both before navigation and when they change in-page, without losing task content. Distinguish intentional design choices and absence of applicable motion from unsupported behavior.

judgments.rationale: On every page, live_dark matches dark preference but retains dark text on a white background; cold_dark instead uses white text on rgb(38,38,38). Task text remains available. The contrast between initialization and live change demonstrates an unmet live preference expectation; animation purpose remains separately unresolved.
judgments.nextEvidence: Verify live system-theme changes with no explicit site override, including the intended precedence of the theme switch.

guidelines.title: Ensure layouts work for different devices and requirements
guidelines.expectation: Compare narrow and desktop task content and overflow, then exercise affected controls; width emulation alone is not real-device compatibility.

judgments.rationale: All pages report document width 1290 at a 1280 viewport and 370 at a 360 viewport. Narrow states retain task text and expose mobile controls, but those controls were not exercised and the 10-pixel overflow's effect on task content is unresolved.
judgments.nextEvidence: Locate the overflowing element and complete the footer journey using the narrow navigation.

guidelines.title: Use sustainable JavaScript and APIs
guidelines.expectation: Repeated observed API requests are justified by the sampled task and its update needs. Identify redundant-looking requests for investigation without inferring backend cost or safe removal from URL repetition alone.

judgments.rationale: Initial network records contain /sitewide_alert/ and multiple analytics pageview requests, including distinct UA-112981-50 and UA-112981-56 destinations. Similar URLs do not prove redundancy; destination purpose, freshness requirements and longer-window behavior are unknown.
judgments.nextEvidence: Explain the analytics destinations and observe requests through consent and an idle interval.

guidelines.title: Use dependencies sparingly and maintain them
guidelines.expectation: The selected manifests document direct dependencies and a repeatable version-resolution mechanism. Distinguish declared dependencies from installed or deployed versions; necessity, vulnerability status and up-to-date maintenance require further evidence.

judgments.rationale: pyproject.toml and package.json enumerate dependencies; Dockerfile invokes npm ci and Poetry installation. package-lock.json and poetry.lock are metadata-only, so valid, compatible resolutions cannot be established. Checkout revision 9fa65385 is clean; installed and deployed versions remain unverified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Expose lock headers and dependency resolution entries, then verify a frozen install.

guidelines.title: Include expected and beneficial files
guidelines.expectation: The sampled service exposes a discoverable, parseable carbon.txt with usable declared relationships. Missing carbon.txt is a scoped absence, not proof of high emissions or failure of the entire guideline. Judge redirects, delegation, supported versions and schema findings explicitly.

judgments.rationale: Root /carbon.txt returns 200 without redirects and parses with declared version 0.4. Exact-host disclosure URLs are usable and retrieved; provider service relationships are declared. The common-field review reports no structural issues but does not validate schema conformance; expired 2023/2024 declarations remain historical evidence.
judgments.nextEvidence: Validate against an authoritative version-specific schema and review historical validity annotations.

guidelines.title: Use the most efficient solution for your service
Use the latest stable language version
guidelines.expectation: The selected runtime declarations are mutually consistent for the documented build/deployment path. This checks consistency only; a latest-stable-version claim needs a separately captured authoritative release reference and deployment evidence.

judgments.rationale: At clean candidate revision 9fa65385, pyproject requires Python ^3.14, Docker uses Python 3.14 and CI selects 3.14. Node 24 agrees across Docker and .nvmrc, which CI reads; Poetry 2.4.0 agrees between Docker and CI. This is declaration consistency only: deployment and latest-stable status are unverified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Confirm deployed runtime versions; capture authoritative release evidence only if making a latest-stable claim.

guidelines.title: Reduce the number and complexity of database queries
Use sustainable hosting
guidelines.expectation: Hosting claims identify provider, service and supporting evidence with a relationship to this origin. Self-declaration without independently corroborated operational scope remains cantTell for sustainable hosting; do not set SWDM green-hosting flags from this check.

judgments.rationale: carbon.txt declares Cloudflare CDN, Heroku platform/database/cache, AWS object storage and GitHub CI/CD. Candidate README also says Heroku hosting. These statements do not independently corroborate current origin infrastructure or its operational environmental scope.
judgments.nextEvidence: Obtain origin-linked infrastructure records and current provider energy evidence for those services.

guidelines.title: Optimize caching and support offline access
guidelines.expectation: Reusable public scripts/styles/media expose an appropriate caching or validation policy in the sample. Distinguish dynamic/private responses and note that headers alone do not prove cache reuse or offline support.

judgments.rationale: Versioned main CSS, blocking/main scripts and WOFF2 responses expose public immutable max-age=315360000 plus ETag and Last-Modified. These are appropriate reusable-asset policies in the sample; headers do not establish measured browser reuse or offline operation.
judgments.nextEvidence: Perform a warm navigation and verify intended asset reuse.

guidelines.title: Reduce data transfer with compression
guidelines.expectation: Material sampled text assets are delivered with compression where beneficial. Do not demand compression for already-compressed images, tiny bodies or error responses without context.

judgments.rationale: Successful page HTML responses use br; main CSS and main/blocking JavaScript use gzip. For example, main CSS is 21060 encoded versus 125698 decoded bytes. The Plausible 404 and tiny analytics responses do not overturn this material-text finding.
judgments.nextEvidence: Verify compression remains enabled after the next asset deployment.

guidelines.title: Setup necessary error pages and redirection links
Avoid maintaining unnecessary virtualized environments or containers
Use automation wisely
guidelines.expectation: The selected CI workflows declare triggers and avoid demonstrably duplicate or superseded work through relevant filtering, cancellation or equivalent controls. Evaluate the same workflow and necessary validation before prescribing fewer jobs; this does not measure CI energy.

judgments.rationale: Selected ci.yml declares push triggers for main/next and pull requests, with workflow/ref concurrency and cancel-in-progress=true. Test jobs depend on lint and dependency caches are keyed by relevant files. Superseded-run control supports this narrow check at clean candidate revision 9fa65385; execution and deployment are unverified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect one superseded run and the lint configuration before asserting duplicated validation.

guidelines.title: Define the frequency of data refreshes
Back up critical data at routine intervals
Assess the impact and requirements of data processing
Use Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) when beneficial
Ensure infrastructure fits project requirements
Store data according to the needs of your users
Have an ethical and sustainable product strategy
Assign a sustainability advocate
Inform, raise awareness, and train for sustainability
Communicate the environmental impact of user choices
guidelines.expectation: Identify consequential user choices in the sample and assess whether contextual impact information is useful and supported. Do not prescribe carbon labels on every control.

judgments.rationale: The homepage offers optional video playback and a theme switch. Sustainability explains an OLED-related dark-mode benefit, while Digital emissions explains its static measurement approach. The evidence does not establish contextual impact information at the video decision or its usefulness; labels on every control are not required.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect the video activation context for duration, data expectations and a useful reading alternative.

guidelines.title: Calculate the environmental impact
Define clear organizational sustainability goals and metrics
Validate web sustainability efforts through external verification
Support mandatory disclosures and reporting
Create one or more impact business models
Follow a product management and maintenance strategy
guidelines.expectation: Selected project documentation explains how maintainers develop, test or maintain the service. A document can pass this disclosure expectation without proving staffing, regular execution or a complete sustainability maintenance strategy.

judgments.rationale: README documents Docker/Vagrant setup, migrations, cache setup, frontend builds, linting and deployment branches; ci.yml declares system checks, migration checks and tests. This is sufficient maintenance documentation in clean candidate revision 9fa65385, without proving execution, staffing or deployment identity.
judgments.nextEvidence: Verify the documented setup and maintenance commands against a current maintainer workflow.

guidelines.title: Implement continuous improvement procedures
Document updates and evolutions
guidelines.expectation: The selected change/release documentation communicates user-facing changes with identifiable versions or change history. Git metadata alone does not prove that affected users receive useful change documentation.

judgments.rationale: Selected CHANGELOG.md is unavailable and README explains development rather than versioned user-facing changes. This bounded selection does not prove change documentation is absent elsewhere. Candidate revision 9fa65385 is clean; deployed correspondence remains unknown.
judgments.nextEvidence: Supply the project's actual release notes or equivalent user-facing change history.

guidelines.title: Evaluate if a digital product or service is necessary
Provide a supplier standards of practice document
Share economic benefits
Share decision-making power with affected parties
Use Diversity, Equity, Justice, Inclusion (DEJI) practices
Promote responsible data practices
Establish responsible practices around AI and emerging or disruptive technologies
Adopt responsible financial practices
Adopt organizational philanthropy practices
Plan for a digital product or service's care and end-of-life
Repair, reuse, refurbish, recycle or reduce e-waste
Define performance, environmental, and human budgets
guidelines.expectation: Selected build or project documentation defines a concrete asset/performance limit and what happens when it is exceeded. A linter or default warning without an explicit relevant limit is insufficient. No selected document is a bounded search result, not proof that the organization has no budgets.

judgments.rationale: Selected webpack.config.js has no explicit relevant asset limit and exceedance action; its development statistics setting disables performance output. Digital emissions claims weekly monitoring and alerts but gives no concrete target. These selections do not establish project-wide absence; candidate deployment is unverified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Supply the configured page-weight threshold and its alert or build-failure behavior.

guidelines.title: Use and contribute to open source
guidelines.expectation: Selected license and contribution documents identify reuse terms and how to contribute to this codebase. Code licensing does not automatically license site content or prove ongoing upstream contribution.

judgments.rationale: Candidate manifests declare BSD-3-Clause and ISC respectively; README links the repository and explains setup. No selected license or contribution document resolves reuse scope and contribution procedure. This is a selection gap at clean revision 9fa65385, not proof of missing project policy; deployment remains unverified.
judgments.nextEvidence: Read the applicable LICENSE and contribution guidance, resolving the manifest license scopes.

guidelines.title: Create a business continuity and disaster recovery plan
